examples.trans: The election is over.
The lesson has ended.

examples.text: Всё, выборы закончились. Тебя начальник ждёт.
examples.trans: That's it, the election is over. Your boss is waiting for you.

meanings.note: High-frequency Russian personal or demonstrative pronoun meaning 'everything', inherited from Common Slavic roots and used constantly in natural spoken dialogue.

examples.text: Не торопись, сначала надо всё обсудить.
examples.trans: Do not hurry, first we need to discuss everything.
These are all my people.

examples.text: Спасибо, друг, ты мне всё понятно объяснил.
examples.trans: Thank you, friend, you explained everything clearly to me.

meanings.note: Manner/predicative adverb in '-о', derived from the neuter short form of the corresponding adjective.

examples.trans: And you will manage it together.
What are you going to manage there?

examples.text: Не будешь ты ими управлять, ясно?
examples.trans: You will not manage them, is that clear?

meanings.note: Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'will find', paired with 'находить'.

examples.trans: I will find you anyway!
Where will I find movers?
I found the phone.
